thread:
maria_cs: Orchard Ops just hit us — repeating 401s for API keys + a sudden billing spike. SIG deadline tomorrow and they need audit logs + keystore/HSM attestation evidence. Can someone take point? :urgent:

orchard_admin: Thanks Maria. We saw ~15% of calls failing 401 between 08:12-08:37 UTC. Customer says it coincided with a rotation they initiated. Need evidence for SIG (beyond the audit form).

maria_cs: Confirmed. They attached a sample request-id: req_0a9b2c. Also sent a screenshot of the billing page showing a tokenization surge.

sam_se: Can we get the exact request_id and a minimal repro curl so SRE can replay? Also need the customer org id.

orchard_admin: org: orchard-ops-prod, request_id: req_0a9b2c, sample curl below:
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"input":"hello"}' \n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
Response: HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
{"error":"invalid_client","message":"API key not found"}

jordan_sre: Thanks. My first suspicion: their key rotation triggered an invalid key edge-case where we still accepted the old key in some regions, then revoked globally — leading to a short window of mismatch and retries that spiked billing. I'll pull the auth audit and token rotation events for orchard-ops-prod 08:00-09:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: [alert] auth-401-rate increased for org=orchard-ops-prod by 14.7% between 08:10-08:40 UTC. Generated incident #(auto) 2023-ORCH-401-01.

nina_security: For the SIG packet they specifically want: (1) per-request audit log sample showing timestamps, IP, principal, request_id; (2) KMS key rotation record (who/when/nonce); (3) HSM attestation statement or link to the last attestation we hold. I'll need the auth-audit export and keystore rotation events.

sam_se: Jordan — can you run the internal export for 08:00-09:00 and paste a couple redacted log lines? Prefer the exact CLI so we can attach to the SIG answer.

jordan_sre: Running now. Command I used:

```
redwoodctl logs export --org orchard-ops-prod --start 2025-11-12T08:00:00Z --end 2025-11-12T09:00:00Z --filter "request_id:req_0a9b2c OR event:token.rotate" --redact secrets --output /tmp/orchard_audit.json
```

Sample (redacted):

````
{"ts":"2025-11-12T08:21:03Z","request_id":"req_0a9b2c","org":"orchard-ops-prod","principal":"api-key-xxxxx","ip":"18.205.12.45","status":401,"reason":"invalid_client"}
{"ts":"2025-11-12T08:22:01Z","event":"token.rotate","actor":"orchard-admin@orchard.com","key_id":"kms://redwood/keys/keystore-7f","rotation_nonce":"r-4eef"}
````

maria_cs: Perfect. Nina — can you confirm we can share the HSM attestation doc with Orchard? Any legal gating?

nina_security: We can share the redacted attestation PDF and a table of rotation metadata. Need to remove internal hostnames. I'll sign off on it. Also want to note: we must avoid putting any private key material in the SIG response — only metadata and the attestation statement.

sam_se: For the billing spike evidence: Jordan, can you pull token usage counts (per-minute) for 07:50-09:10 so we can show the retry storm? That will help the customer and finance.

jordan_sre: Yep. Command:
```
redwoodctl metrics query --org orchard-ops-prod --metric tokens_consumed --start 2025-11-12T07:50Z --end 2025-11-12T09:10Z --group-by minute > /tmp/orchard_tokens.csv
```
CSV head: 
``n2025-11-12T08:18:00Z, 1240
2025-11-12T08:19:00Z, 1385
2025-11-12T08:20:00Z, 21400  <-- burst
2025-11-12T08:21:00Z, 22000
2025-11-12T08:22:00Z, 1600
```

orchard_admin: That 08:20 spike is what we saw on our billing UI. We paged our infra team because legitimate traffic should not jump like that.

maria_cs: Action items: Jordan export full audit slice + token metric CSV and upload to secure share; Nina prepare redacted HSM attestation + rotation table; Sam draft SIG response language for the bespoke question about retention & rotation timeline. I'll be the owner to deliver to customer before EOD tomorrow (SIG due).

sam_se: Draft suggestion: "Rotation occurred at 2025-11-12T08:22Z and coincided with a client-side re-try storm. Redwood accepted a small number of in-flight requests using the prior token in region eu-west-1 for ~30s while global revocation propagated; these requests were then rejected post-revocation resulting in increased token consumption from retries. We have attached per-request audit logs and rotation records." Thoughts?

nina_security: Sounds accurate. Add: "No secret material is shared; attestation and rotation metadata are provided. We've added guidance for future rotations (grace window + recommended client retry backoff) in the appendix."

jordan_sre: I'll put the export on the secure share and paste link here when ready. Expecting ~5MB JSON.

deploy-bot: [update] incident 2023-ORCH-401-01 -> status: monitoring.

jordan_sre: Upload: https://secure-share.redwood.internal/s/orchard-exports/2025-11-12-auth-audit.json (redacted)

maria_cs: Got it. Nina, attaching draft SIG Q+A to this thread in 10m. Sam — can you review before I send?

sam_se: Reviewing now. If anyone needs me to call the customer for clarifying repro, I can join.

orchard_admin: Appreciate the fast response team. One last ask from legal: a short statement confirming we did not export any private key material. Can you include that in the SIG packet?

nina_security: Will include an explicit line: "No private key material or unredacted secrets were exported to customer."

maria_cs: Great. I'll package: audit export, token CSV, HSM attestation PDF (redacted), rotation table, and the signed legal line. Sending to Orchard and filing SIG response by EOD tomorrow. Assigning follow-up to @sam_se for billing reconciliation and to @jordan_sre for postmortem notes. :thumbsup:

sam_se: Ack.

jordan_sre: Ack. I'll capture a short postmortem and add suggested changes to the rotation playbook (add 60s grace + backoff example).

maria_cs: Closing thread prep. Thanks team.
